debit.notes: 24x7 IVR blocking. Kotak Mobile app: Settings > Debit Card > Block. 24x7 fraud reporting helpline: 1800-209-0000.

upi.notes: No dedicated UPI freeze/deregister menu path is published on Kotak's official pages (help-centre and UPI pages swept 2026-10-31). Published in-app UPI controls (Kotak Mobile Banking app): menu path 'BHIM UPI' under 'Pay & Transfer' section > 'Pending Money Requests' > 'Reject & Block' rejects and blocks a fraudulent collect request — the only published UPI-ID block ('If you receive any fraudulent Collect Request, you can reject it, and then you will get an option to block the UPI ID'). Fraud emergency: 'You can then ask to block your debit / credit card & other channels like Net banking and Mobile banking by calling our 24x7 helpline number 1800 209 0000' (fraud FAQ; UPI is not named in that channel list). General 24x7 toll-free helpline 1800 4100 (contact-us page). androidApp/iosApp are the official store listings of the Kotak Bank app (publisher Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd) whose store description covers UPI. No netbanking UPI manage path and no SMS/USSD UPI channel published.
